average.title: Average Units/Day
average.remarks: Average units per day for this AssetMeter

lastreadingdate.title: Last Reading Date
lastreadingdate.remarks: Date of last reading for this location meter.

sinceinstall.title: Since Install
sinceinstall.remarks: Difference between the current meter reading and the meter reading when this LocationMeter's location was moved into its current configuration.

lastreading.title: Last Reading
lastreading.remarks: Last reading taken for this location meter

domainid.title: Domain
domainid.remarks: Non-persistent attribute. For LocationMeters associated with CHARACTERISTIC meters only, this attribute holds domain information from the Meter.  This domain information is used to validate a new CHARACTERISTIC measurement.

sincelastinspect.title: Since Last Inspection
sincelastinspect.remarks: Difference between the current meter reading and the meter reading when the last work order of type INSPECTION was opened or closed as determined by application setup.

rollover.title: Rollover
rollover.remarks: Point at which the location's meter returns to the its mininum value.  Rollover applies to CONTINUOUS meters only.

avgcalcmethod.title: Average Calculation Method
avgcalcmethod.remarks: Method used to calculate the average meter units per day:  STATIC, ALL or SLIDING.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: Name of user who last modified this record.

active.title: Active
active.remarks: Is this location's meter available to accept manual or rolled down readings, or to be used in PM or CM work order generation?

changedate.title: Changed Date
changedate.remarks: Date and time record was last modified.

lastreadinginspctr.title: Last Reading Inspector
lastreadinginspctr.remarks: inspector for this assetmeter's most recent meter reading

previousreadingdate.title: Previous Reading Date
previousreadingdate.remarks: non-persistent attribute that is the date of the location meter reading just previous to the location meter reading being added or updated.

sincelastrepair.title: Since Last Repair
sincelastrepair.remarks: Difference between current meter reading and the meter reading when the last work order was opened or closed as determined by the application setup.

lifetodate.title: Life to Date for Location
lifetodate.remarks: Total readings over the life of this location.

measureunitid.title: Unit of Measure
measureunitid.remarks: Measure unit for the meter when attached to this location, for example LITERS or RPM

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Identifier for the meter attached to the location, for example HOURS or KILOMETERS.

sincelastoverhaul.title: Since Last Overhaul
sincelastoverhaul.remarks: Difference between the current meter reading and the meter reading when the last work order of type OVERHAUL was opened or closed as determined by application setup.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Location to which the meter is attached

previousreading.title: Previous Reading
previousreading.remarks: non-persistent attribute that is the reading just previous to the location meter reading being added or updated.

dorollover.title: Rollover
dorollover.remarks: non-persistent attribute to indicate if a new reading should cause the meter to roll over

readingtype.title: Reading Type
readingtype.remarks: reading type (CONTINUOUS or DELTA) for this LocationMeter. Location meter readings default to this LocationMeter's readingtype value.

slidingwindowsize.title: Sliding Window Size
slidingwindowsize.remarks: The number of readings, days, weeks or months to include in a sliding average meter unit calculation.

pointnum.title: Point
pointnum.remarks: identifier of this LocationMeter's related condition monitoring point.  A condition monitoring point is related if it shares this LocationMeter's Location and MeterName

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.remarks: Additional information supplied by the user regarding the LocationMeter record.
